官方 CLI 登录资料保存在本机；本页面不读取或上传 Cookie、浏览器 Pr: Official CLI credentials stay on this machine. This page never reads or uploads cookies, browser profiles, or login tokens.
直接读取当前 Windows 用户的官方即梦 CLI 登录状态。: Reads the official Dreamina CLI sign-in status for the current Windows user directly.
连接本机服务后自动检测: Detected automatically once the local service connects
重新连接本机服务后，将自动读取官方 CLI 状态。: The official CLI status is read automatically after reconnecting the local service.
账号生成权限：未知。当前页面只确认本机适配器支持与登录状态；具体账号是否可生成，: Account generation permission: unknown. This page only verifies adapter support and sign-in state; whether the account can generate is decided by the official service.
任务状态通过后台轮询最终同步，不是实时推送；关闭页面不会停止已经提交的官方任务。: Task states are synced by backend polling, not pushed in real time. Closing the page does not stop officially submitted tasks.
官方 Dreamina CLI 当前不提供取消命令；官方已接受的任务只能转入后台: The official Dreamina CLI offers no cancel command. Accepted tasks keep syncing in the background instead of being faked as cancelled.
本机任务运行期间，请不要在其他程序中切换 Dreamina CLI 账号；外部换: Do not switch Dreamina CLI accounts in other apps while local tasks run; account switches elsewhere cannot be detected here in real time.
请先连接已加载 Dreamina 的本机运行时: Connect a local runtime with Dreamina loaded first
请打开官方验证页完成授权，再刷新状态: Complete authorization on the official verification page, then refresh status
未检测到官方 Dreamina CLI。请按官方说明安装并确保命令在 PATH: Official Dreamina CLI not detected. Install it per the official guide, make sure it is on PATH, then click Refresh status. No unverified installers ship with this version.
只清除当前 OS 用户的官方 CLI 登录状态。: Only clears the official CLI sign-in state for this OS user.
当前 Runtime 未加载 Dreamina 模块，请更新并重启 Runtim: The current runtime has no Dreamina module loaded. Update and restart the runtime.
